about: Hand-checked option text for mock_fomod_corpus.py measure. 'expect' is a short piece of the readme line that must appear in the option's text; null means the readme has nothing about this option, so no text should be shown. 'baseline' records whether the matcher in use when the entry was written got it right: an entry that passes must keep passing.
